title: AM-MODEL-REPOSITORY-STANDARD declaration (standard.yaml)
description: Validates the repository-standard adoption declaration of an Assessment-Models maturity-model repository (CR-AM-ORG-RES-000). model.yaml remains the authoritative identity manifest; this declaration cross-references it and is CI-checked for coherence.

type.description: Must equal model.yaml type. Only maturity-model repositories adopt this standard.

version.description: Published SemVer version of the standard this repository conforms to.

name.description: Human-readable model name; must equal model.yaml name.

version.description: Must equal model.yaml version and the VERSION file; cross-checked by CI.
